item.title: Yume no Yukue Karuizawa Monogatari
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Fair Dance
  • 発売日: 1998-02-05
  • スコア: なし (1 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 夢のゆくえ 軽井沢物語
  • 英語名: Yume no Yukue Karuizawa Monogatari

あらすじ

In Autumn wandering in the forest of Karuizawa I met a girl in a white dress living in an old villa.

In winter three of my classmates and I came to ski and I had a vision of a girl in white dress again..

In spring I walked in the forest of Karuizawa to find a girl in white dress.
